3. The prosecution case, as it appears from the evidence of P.W.1, the informant was that on 19.05.1998 when his nephew, Aslam Ali (the deceased) demanded money from accused Altaf Ali Bepari for giving water in his land for irrigation an altercation took place between them. The matter was settled by the persons present there, but accused Altaf Bepari did not forget the incident at all. On the night of that very day, a meeting was held at the house of accused Elas Bepari (the petitioner) where all the accused being 52 in number including the petitioner were present. On 20.05.1998 at about 10 a.m. the accused came at the ghat of Mafiz being armed with pipegun, ramdao, holonga, kirij, rod etc. Accused Shahid Bepari after raking of the position of the inmates of the house of Mafiz Bepari gave a Signal to all the accused to get down from the trawler and then all the accused being armed with the said articles got down from the trawler. Shahid Bepari ordered to finish all the inmates of the house of Mafia Bepari as well as P.W.1 and on such order the convict petitioner gave a holonga blow on the right chest wall of the deceased causing bleeding injury. The petitioner dragged the deceased from his room and then accused Shahid Bepari gave a blow on his neck. The petitioner sat on the chest of the deceased and assaulted him with a rod. Accused Altaf Ali caused grievous injury on the testicle of the deceased by pressing the same. Accused Sonamuddin caused injury by giving rod blow on the chest of the deceased. When the father of the deceased came to rescue him accused driver gave a ramdao blow on his head causing bleeding injury. Accused Mukhles and Tulu caused injury on the person of Mafiz by a rod. When witness Shahjahan went to help the deceased, accused Pervej gave a ramdao blow on his head causing bleeding injury. Accused Chhalu and Dulal caused injuries on the body of Shahjahan with rod, when witness Augur went to rescue the deceased, accused Dhan Miah gave a kirij blow on his right thigh causing bleeding injury. Accused Chhalu also caused bleeding injury with holonga blow on the right thigh of witness Augur. When witness Rahima went to rescue her sons, namely, Augur and Anwar, accused Dhan Miah gave a holonga blow on their right thigh causing bleeding injury. When witness Joshua went to help the deceased, accused Asab gave a rod below on her head causing grievous injury. The other accused also assaulted the injured persons indiscriminately. The accused also caused damage to the house of the informant and Mafiz to the tune of TK.15,000.00(Taka fifteen thousand). 

 8. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and order of conviction and sentence passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge the petitioner along with the other convict preferred Criminal Appeal No.416 of 2005 before the High Court Division. A Division Bench of the High Court Division which heard the appeal by the impugned judgment and order though acquitted all the other appellants of the charge brought against them under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code, yet maintained the order of conviction and sentence passed against the petitioner, hence this petition for leave to appeal has been filed by him before this Division.
